_note: Generated genre gear for D62e (not from the core rulebook). Modeled on the book's Equipment by Genre/Era style: most items grant a +1D/+2D die-code bonus to a relevant skill, others are descriptive. page:0 marks these as generated, not a printed page. Tagged by genre (fantasy/scifi/superhero) and an era so the era filter surfaces them.

equipment.name: Thieves' Tools
equipment.description: Picks, tension wrenches and a small pry bar; grants +1D to lockpicking and to disarming mechanical traps. Locks and traps generally can't be attempted without them.

equipment.name: Herbalism Kit
equipment.description: Pouches of dried herbs, a mortar and clean cloth; adds +1D to Medicine die codes and lets a character brew simple remedies or antitoxins.

equipment.name: Alchemist's Kit
equipment.description: Vials, reagents and a portable burner; grants +1D to rolls to identify substances or mix simple compounds (acid, smoke, fire-flasks).

equipment.name: Disguise Kit
equipment.description: Wigs, cosmetics and costume pieces; grants +1D to rolls to alter one's appearance and pass as someone else.

equipment.name: Forgery Kit
equipment.description: Inks, seals, blank parchment and fine pens; grants +1D to create or to spot forged documents and seals.

equipment.name: Holy Symbol
equipment.description: A consecrated icon of a faith; a divine caster uses it as a focus and gains +1D to rolls to ward or turn undead and unholy foes.

equipment.name: Spell Component Pouch
equipment.description: A belt pouch of reagents and foci. Many spells require it; without one, casting those spells is at +5 to +10 Difficulty.

equipment.name: Grimoire
equipment.description: A caster's book of recorded spells and notes. A wizard separated from it prepares or researches spells at +5 to +10 Difficulty.

equipment.name: Hooded Lantern
equipment.description: An oil lantern with an adjustable shutter; reduces the Difficulty of tests in the dark (by -5 or -10) and can be dimmed to a sliver of light.

equipment.name: Ten-foot Pole
equipment.description: A humble but beloved probe; grants +1D to rolls to detect floor traps, pressure plates or unstable ground ahead of you.

equipment.name: Caltrops
equipment.description: A bag of spiked jacks scattered across the ground. A creature moving through the area at speed must make an Agility roll or take 2D damage and be slowed.

equipment.name: Manacles
equipment.description: Iron restraints for wrists or ankles. A bound captive escapes only with a hard Agility or Brawn roll (GM sets the Difficulty).

equipment.name: Oilskin Cloak
equipment.description: A waxed traveler's cloak; grants +1D to Stamina rolls against cold and wet, and keeps carried gear dry.

equipment.name: Antitoxin Vial
equipment.description: A single dose of remedy; drunk in time, it grants +2D to resist one poison for the rest of the scene.

equipment.name: Signal Whistle
equipment.description: A shrill whistle heard clearly across a battlefield or through a dungeon; useful for signaling allies at a distance.

equipment.name: Bag of Holding
equipment.description: An enchanted sack whose interior is far larger than its opening; it holds a wagon's worth of goods yet weighs only a few pounds.

equipment.name: Everburning Torch
equipment.description: A torch wreathed in cold, magical flame that never consumes and cannot be doused by wind or water; reduces dark Difficulty by -5 or -10.

equipment.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
equipment.description: A shifting grey-green cloak; while worn with the hood up, it grants +1D to Sneak and hiding rolls.

equipment.name: Ring of Warmth
equipment.description: A plain band that radiates gentle heat; grants +2D to Stamina rolls against cold and lets the wearer ignore harsh but non-lethal chill.

equipment.name: Potion of Climbing
equipment.description: A single-use draught; for one scene the drinker gains +2D to Climbing and can scale sheer surfaces.

equipment.name: Potion of Invisibility
equipment.description: A single-use draught; the drinker turns invisible for one scene or until they attack, granting a large bonus to hide and to surprise foes.

equipment.name: Arcane Focus
equipment.description: A crystal, wand or rune-etched rod attuned to one spell specialization (Change, Movement, Creation or Knowledge); grants +1D to casting rolls of that specialization.

equipment.name: Medkit
equipment.description: A field medical kit of sealant, stims and diagnostic strips; adds +1D to Medicine die codes.

equipment.name: Medical Scanner
equipment.description: A handheld diagnostic sensor; grants +1D to Medicine rolls to diagnose injuries, toxins and diseases, and reveals a patient's condition at a glance.

equipment.name: Datapad
equipment.description: A slate computer with network access; grants +1D to Computers and research rolls and stores vast reference data.

equipment.name: Multitool
equipment.description: A compact powered tool with interchangeable heads; adds +1D to Use-Repair rolls to fix or jury-rig machinery.

equipment.name: Engineering Toolkit
equipment.description: A full case of powered tools and diagnostics; grants +2D to Use-Repair and Upgrade rolls but is bulky and slow to deploy.

equipment.name: Sensor Visor
equipment.description: A visor overlaying thermal and motion data; grants +1D to search and Perception rolls to spot hidden objects, lifeforms or heat signatures.

equipment.name: Rebreather
equipment.description: A compact air recycler; grants +2D to Stamina rolls against airless, smoke-filled or toxic atmospheres for its charge duration.

equipment.name: Grav Boots
equipment.description: Magnetic-grav soled boots; let the wearer walk hull-plating and bulkheads and grant +1D to maneuver in zero gravity.

equipment.name: Jetpack
equipment.description: A short-burn thruster pack; grants brief personal flight (a few rounds per charge) for crossing gaps or gaining height.

equipment.name: Hacking Rig
equipment.description: A concealed deck of intrusion software and spike hardware; grants +2D to Computers rolls to breach systems and defeat electronic security.

equipment.name: Universal Translator
equipment.description: A worn earpiece that parses spoken language; grants +1D to Languages rolls to understand and be understood by an unknown tongue.

equipment.name: Comlink
equipment.description: A short-range personal communicator; keeps a team in contact across a city or a ship's decks, longer with a relay.

equipment.name: Power Cell
equipment.description: A rechargeable high-density battery; powers or reloads energy weapons and devices. A spare cell is a common lifesaver.

equipment.name: Security Spike
equipment.description: A single-use bypass chip; grants +1D to defeat one electronic lock or panel, then burns out.

equipment.name: Personal Cloaking Field
equipment.description: A light-bending emitter worn on the belt; while active (a limited duration) it grants +2D to Sneak and hiding rolls, but flickers if the wearer moves fast.

equipment.name: Stimpack
equipment.description: An auto-injector of combat drugs; used as an action it removes the Stunned or Wounded condition once. Repeated use in a scene risks a Stamina penalty.

equipment.name: Environmental Analyzer
equipment.description: A pocket sensor reading atmosphere, radiation and biology; grants +1D to Survival and Knowledge rolls about local hazards on a strange world.

equipment.name: Nano-Bandage
equipment.description: A patch seeded with medical nanites; applied to a wound it grants +1D to natural healing and stops bleeding.

equipment.name: Holo-Projector
equipment.description: A palm emitter that casts convincing three-dimensional images or a decoy of the user; grants +1D to Deceive rolls that rely on a visual ruse.

equipment.name: Grapple Launcher
equipment.description: A compressed-air line launcher; grants +1D to Climbing and lets the user ascend or swing across a gap as a single action.

equipment.name: Smoke Pellets
equipment.description: Palmed capsules that burst into concealing smoke; grant +2D to escape or hide for a round and impose penalties on attacks through the cloud.

equipment.name: Tracer Beacon
equipment.description: A tiny adhesive transmitter; tag a target or vehicle and follow its signal across the city on a paired receiver.

equipment.name: Night-Vision Goggles
equipment.description: Light-amplifying optics; negate darkness penalties and grant +1D to Perception rolls to see in low light.

equipment.name: Forensics Kit
equipment.description: Lifts prints, samples and trace evidence; grants +1D to investigation and search rolls when working a scene.

equipment.name: Comms Earpiece
equipment.description: A concealed team radio; keeps a hero and their allies coordinated across a city block or a whole operation with a relay.

equipment.name: Rebreather Mask
equipment.description: A slim filter mask; grants +2D to Stamina rolls against gas, smoke and brief underwater work.

equipment.name: Zip-Line Gun
equipment.description: Fires an anchored line for rapid traversal; grants +1D to rolls to cross rooftops or descend quickly and safely.

equipment.name: Electronic Lockpick
equipment.description: A powered decryption pick; grants +1D to bypass mechanical and electronic locks and alarm panels.

equipment.name: Micro-Camera
equipment.description: A button-sized camera or listening bug; plant it to surveil a room and stream to a receiver. Easily missed by the unwary.

equipment.name: First-Aid Spray
equipment.description: A medical aerosol; used as an action it removes the Stunned condition or downgrades a Wounded result once per scene.

equipment.name: Exo-Gauntlets
equipment.description: Servo-assisted gloves; grant +2D to Brawn rolls to lift, bend or break, and let the wearer punch through light barriers.

equipment.name: Holo-Disguise Projector
equipment.description: A belt unit that overlays a false appearance; grants +2D to disguise and to pass as someone else, but a solid touch or a scanner can reveal the ruse.

equipment.name: Hacking Gauntlet
equipment.description: A wrist deck for on-the-fly intrusion; grants +2D to rolls to breach cameras, doors and networks in the field.

equipment.name: EMP Grenade
equipment.description: A thrown pulse charge; disables unshielded electronics, drones and powered devices within a few meters for the scene. Harmless to living targets.

equipment.name: Buckler
equipment.description: A small strapped shield; adds its bonus to the Brawn roll to resist damage and is light enough to wield alongside a one-handed weapon.

equipment.name: Personal Energy Shield
equipment.description: A belt-worn deflector field; adds its bonus to Brawn rolls to resist damage (stronger against energy) while its cell holds a charge.

equipment.name: Reinforced Costume
equipment.description: A woven protective bodysuit under the colors; adds its bonus to the Brawn roll to resist damage without hampering movement.
